title: SGD in Multiclass Logistic Regression: Sequential Learning and Scaling Laws
abstract: arXiv:2609.07868v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the training dynamics of multiclass logistic regression on high-dimensional Gaussian mixture models with a large number of classes and establish precise scaling laws governing the cross-entropy risk under gradient-based optimization. We show that learning proceeds sequentially across classes, from most to least frequent. When the class priors follow a power law distribution, the risk dynamics decompose into three phases: an initial plateau until the first class is learned, a power-law decay regime during which sequential learning occurs, and a final convergence regime.   We then analyze how model capacity interacts with optimization under a fixed compute budget. When the effective dimension is restricted via projection onto leading principal components, the risk decomposes into a capacity term (a power law in the retained dimension) and an optimization term (a power law in training time). translated_title: 多类别逻辑回归中的SGD：序贯学习与标度律
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在具有大量类别的高维高斯混合模型上，多类别逻辑回归的训练动态，并建立了基于梯度优化下交叉熵风险的精确标度律。我们证明学习是按类别从最频繁到最不频繁依次序贯进行的。当类别先验服从幂律分布时，风险动态分解为三个阶段：在学习到第一个类别之前的初始平台期、发生序贯学习的幂律衰减阶段，以及最终的收敛阶段。随后，我们分析了在固定计算预算下模型容量与优化之间的相互作用。当通过投影到前几个主成分来限制有效维度时，风险分解为容量项（关于保留维度的幂律）和优化项（关于训练时间的幂律）。优化这一权衡产生了一个……
tldr: 该论文证明了多类别逻辑回归在高维高斯混合模型上的学习按类别频率从高到低序贯进行，交叉熵风险随训练时间呈幂律衰减，且在固定计算预算下容量项与优化项之间存在精确可刻画的幂律权衡。
